comment: Approved secondary-source values per 100 g for Script B curated lookup. Only add entries with credible, food-specific attribution. Script B will not apply an entry to a food unless slugs includes that food. Currently contains only the salmon–astaxanthin entry.

astaxanthin.label: Astaxanthin
astaxanthin.source_note: Literature estimate for farmed Atlantic salmon; carotenoid content varies by feed and species (e.g. Turujman et al., 1997; USDA does not report astaxanthin).
